name: @innis/nostr-event-store
description: In-memory event cache + IndexedDB-backed event store for Nostr events. One NIP-01 filter language across memory, IndexedDB, peek, and subscriptions; atomic replaceable writes via a unique index.

tasks.coverage: rm -rf cov_profile && deno test -A --coverage=cov_profile && deno coverage cov_profile --lcov --output=cov_profile/lcov.info && deno coverage cov_profile && deno run --allow-read scripts/check-coverage.ts
tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task coverage && deno task exports-tested && deno task docs
